args.rationale: The baseline projection shows 1,400 units of total forecast demand against 800 units of usable on-hand inventory for SKU-1006 at NODE-BOG-F6, resulting in a 600-unit shortage starting on 2026-10-03 and 16 days below safety stock. While ordering 600 units from SUP-A at $10.00/unit would eliminate the unmet demand, the order cost of $6,000.00 (or $8,000.00 for 800 units to maintain safety stock) is infeasible due to an available budget of $0.00, which is a hard constraint. Keeping the current plan leaves 600 units of demand unserved. Because no feasible plan resolves the shortage, the case is escalated for a budget increase of at least $6,000.00 (or $8,000.00 to also cover safety stock).
assumptions: Baseline daily forecast of 50 units/day across 28 days remains the active demand projection as modeled in simulate_plan.
